'''Aralia''' was a tiny, semi-tropical [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Aralia system/Legends|Andron system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]].

==History==
Under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-trade was outlawed and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] the substance was made a capital offense in [[980 BBY]]. Aralia continued to see success as a resort world, but suffered a setback when a spice-smuggler crash-landed in the jungles. On board the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was a nest of [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], a mildly-intelligent [[Species/Legends|species]] which had evolved on the planet [[Rydar II]]. Calling themselves the ''Con Qeecon'' or "the conquerors", the Ranats quickly multiplied and began building their underground maze of warrens. Infesting the ground and depleting the food supply of many of the native wildlife, the Ranats became more of a nuisance then a welcome co-inhabitant of the world.<ref name="GG4" />

Joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when the CIS was defeated. Under Imperial rule, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants initiated<ref name="GG4" /> [[Project Aralia]],<ref name="AS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> a massive [[amusement park]] designed to boost the economy on Aralia. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the Ranat colonies, which each maintained a population of one hundred individuals, began to interfere in the construction of the massive park. Angered, the Humans called for their eradication and the Empire obliged. The Imperial governor issued a decree stating that Ranats could be killed in self-defense and that they were barred from purchasing or owning weapons. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] personally helped to drug groups of Ranats and use them as guards for some of the extermination camps built on the planet.<ref name="GG4" />
